findings.what: groupGone/waitGroupGone do not refuse a group id <= 1 the way signalGroup now does; kill(-pgid, 0) with 0 or 1 only probes, sends nothing, and answers 'alive', so stopGroup on such an id would wait grace + 3 s and report false. No caller can pass such an id (pids come from spawn). Info level.
findings.fix: Optional: return true (gone) or throw for a non-integer or <= 1 id in groupGone.
